readings: For every invoice, including those with no line items (count 0, no average), show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
queries:
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(1.0 * li.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(li.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio,
    COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li
    ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number
LIMIT 10
